overview: Google dominated the day with Gemini 4 Neon. It is a fast, cheaper model that Google and its executives say ranks near the top of benchmarks, and Genie 4 world models also went live. On the money side, Bill Ackman says he is still bullish on Microsoft despite share sales shown in his 13F. Anthropic's IPO is drawing fire from AI-safety figures. A new pre-auth NGINX exploit is worth acting on if you run NGINX.

top_items.title: Koray Kavukcuoglu - Google's Gemini 4 Neon launches; Google says #3 on Artificial Analysis and #2 on Vals Index, with a 1M-token context
Greg Brockman - OpenAI helped find NGINX2Shell, a pre-auth remote code exploit in NGINX 1.31.8, the current mainline release
Bill Ackman - Pershing sold ~2M MSFT shares but bought 2M deep-in-the-money options at a ~$310 strike, running 2.5 years
David Sacks - Tegmark signs an anti-Anthropic statement on its IPO day, saying the company races toward self-improving AI while warning about it
Greg Brockman - OpenAI says its models found up to 14% power/performance/area gains on AMD flagship GPU designs in under 5 months
Elon Musk - SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time; Musk calls it the last major piece of full reuse
Google AI - Genie 4 world model goes live in Project Genie, with real-time editing, native audio and a remixable community gallery
Greg Brockman - ChatGPT for Accounting launches, with plugins for QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and BILL covering reconciliation and month-end
